title: Claude via Unreal MCP spawns CineCamera and keyframes a full cinematic shot
summary: Demo where Claude controls Unreal through MCP to spawn a CineCamera, create a Level Sequence with camera cuts, keyframe a slow dolly through a foggy cathedral scene, and add fades—no manual Sequencer work claimed.
question_it_answers: Can an agent author a full Unreal cinematic camera move end-to-end through MCP without hand-keyframing Sequencer?

claims.text: Claude via Unreal MCP spawns CineCamera, creates a Level Sequence with camera cuts, keyframes a slow dolly, and runs the shot live without manual Sequencer work.
claims.evidence:
Claude takes control through Unreal MCP
> Spawns CineCamera
> Creates Level Sequence
> Adds Camera Cut track
> Keyframes slow dolly to the altar
